meta.title: Grave Travelers
meta.description: When you choose to set foot on the battlefield, when you choose to arm yourself, when you choose to face the enemy, you are an unyielding warrior, your soul ablaze with fighting spirit.

units.rawText: At "The Hands of Venus".
units.displayText: At "The Hands of Venus".

units.rawText: Dad! Dad...
units.displayText: Dad! Dad...

spans.text: Dad! Dad...

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka... He's dead... What... what should we do now?
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka... He's dead... What... what should we do now?

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka... He's dead... What... what should we do now?

units.rawText: The enemy will send people to investigate the explosion soon. We should go before their reinforcements show up.
units.displayText: The enemy will send people to investigate the explosion soon. We should go before their reinforcements show up.

units.rawText: Wait! Then, then what about me? What should I do?!
units.displayText: Wait! Then, then what about me? What should I do?!

spans.text: Wait! Then, then what about me? What should I do?!

units.rawText: There's fighting everywhere in the city. Having you and Chris stay on the battlefield will be very dangerous... Tony, do you think you can use your status as a UAS Doll to leave this city?
units.displayText: There's fighting everywhere in the city. Having you and Chris stay on the battlefield will be very dangerous... Tony, do you think you can use your status as a UAS Doll to leave this city?

units.displayText: If I were alone, I might be able to pass their checkpoints, but now...

spans.text: If I were alone, I might be able to pass their checkpoints, but now...

units.displayText: Tony glances over to Chris, who is still sobbing quietly, and he is silent for a while.

units.displayText: Centaureissi kneels down in front of Chris and gently dabs away the blood and grime on his face.

spans.text: Centaureissi kneels down in front of Chris and gently dabs away the blood and grime on his face.

units.rawText: She doesn't try to comfort him. Instead, she gently scoops him into her arms and lets him cry as much as he wants.
units.displayText: She doesn't try to comfort him. Instead, she gently scoops him into her arms and lets him cry as much as he wants.

spans.text: She doesn't try to comfort him. Instead, she gently scoops him into her arms and lets him cry as much as he wants.

units.rawText: ...Indeed, we can't let his determination go to waste.
units.displayText: ...Indeed, we can't let his determination go to waste.

spans.text: ...Indeed, we can't let his determination go to waste.

units.rawText: As such, Centaureissi will carry out the mission once we escort the two of you out of this place.
units.displayText: As such, Centaureissi will carry out the mission once we escort the two of you out of this place.

spans.text: As such, Centaureissi will carry out the mission once we escort the two of you out of this place.

units.rawText: ...No need to go to that trouble, Commander.
units.displayText: ...No need to go to that trouble, Commander.

spans.text: ...No need to go to that trouble, Commander.

units.rawText: I know a route that will take us out of the city. It's in the same direction as the safehouse, Commander.
units.displayText: I know a route that will take us out of the city. It's in the same direction as the safehouse, Commander.

spans.text: I know a route that will take us out of the city. It's in the same direction as the safehouse, Commander.

units.rawText: ...Centaureissi, do you have any information about this route?
units.displayText: ...Centaureissi, do you have any information about this route?

spans.text: ...Centaureissi, do you have any information about this route?

units.rawText: No. I am not familiar with it. I have never heard of it before...
units.displayText: No. I am not familiar with it. I have never heard of it before...

spans.text: No. I am not familiar with it. I have never heard of it before...

units.rawText: But it really exists! Please believe me, Commander!
units.displayText: But it really exists! Please believe me, Commander!

spans.text: But it really exists! Please believe me, Commander!

units.rawText: Also... I, I also know a few shortcuts leading to the safehouse! Please, Commander, take me with you!
units.displayText: Also... I, I also know a few shortcuts leading to the safehouse! Please, Commander, take me with you!

spans.text: Also... I, I also know a few shortcuts leading to the safehouse! Please, Commander, take me with you!

units.displayText: Chris' little fists tremble as he clenches them, and the tears well up in his eyes.

spans.text: Chris' little fists tremble as he clenches them, and the tears well up in his eyes.

units.rawText: I choose not to point out his lie. Instead, I ruffle his hair and smooth out the creases in his clothes.
units.displayText: I choose not to point out his lie. Instead, I ruffle his hair and smooth out the creases in his clothes.

spans.text: I choose not to point out his lie. Instead, I ruffle his hair and smooth out the creases in his clothes.

units.rawText: I believe you, Chris. Take care of us, okay?
units.displayText: I believe you, Chris. Take care of us, okay?

spans.text: I believe you, Chris. Take care of us, okay?

units.rawText: ...A-Alright! No... I mean, yes, Commander!
units.displayText: ...A-Alright! No... I mean, yes, Commander!

spans.text: ...A-Alright! No... I mean, yes, Commander!

units.rawText: Chris smiles, and then he bows awkwardly to me.
units.displayText: Chris smiles, and then he bows awkwardly to me.

spans.text: Chris smiles, and then he bows awkwardly to me.

units.rawText: Well, that's Chris taken care of. What do you plan to do next, Tony?
units.displayText: Well, that's Chris taken care of. What do you plan to do next, Tony?

spans.text: Well, that's Chris taken care of. What do you plan to do next, Tony?

units.rawText: I... As for me...
units.displayText: I... As for me...

spans.text: I... As for me...

units.rawText: Tony seems a little zoned out as he stares at the bloodstained watch. Then he shakes his head and smiles bitterly.
units.displayText: Tony seems a little zoned out as he stares at the bloodstained watch. Then he shakes his head and smiles bitterly.

spans.text: Tony seems a little zoned out as he stares at the bloodstained watch. Then he shakes his head and smiles bitterly.

units.rawText: I don't want to disappoint Lieutenant Izka either, so I'll go with you... Even though I can't really do anything to help.
units.displayText: I don't want to disappoint Lieutenant Izka either, so I'll go with you... Even though I can't really do anything to help.

spans.text: I don't want to disappoint Lieutenant Izka either, so I'll go with you... Even though I can't really do anything to help.

units.rawText: Indeed, you cannot fight as you have no combat modules. Thus, I shall entrust the task of taking care of Chris to you.
units.displayText: Indeed, you cannot fight as you have no combat modules. Thus, I shall entrust the task of taking care of Chris to you.

spans.text: Indeed, you cannot fight as you have no combat modules. Thus, I shall entrust the task of taking care of Chris to you.

units.rawText: While it may be true... hearing that straight up kind of hurts my feelings.
units.displayText: While it may be true... hearing that straight up kind of hurts my feelings.

spans.text: While it may be true... hearing that straight up kind of hurts my feelings.

units.rawText: ...You're as kind as I remember, Tony.
units.displayText: ...You're as kind as I remember, Tony.

spans.text: ...You're as kind as I remember, Tony.

units.rawText: Hm? Did you say something, Commander?
units.displayText: Hm? Did you say something, Commander?

spans.text: Hm? Did you say something, Commander?

units.rawText: No, it's nothing... Welcome aboard, Tony.
units.displayText: No, it's nothing... Welcome aboard, Tony.

spans.text: No, it's nothing... Welcome aboard, Tony.

units.rawText: Time is tight. Everyone, get your things together and then we'll set out for the safehouse outside the city!
units.displayText: Time is tight. Everyone, get your things together and then we'll set out for the safehouse outside the city!

spans.text: Time is tight. Everyone, get your things together and then we'll set out for the safehouse outside the city!

units.rawText: <size=40>Yes, Commander!</size>
units.displayText: Yes, Commander!

spans.text: Yes, Commander!

units.rawText: Is this the safehouse the Lieutenant was talking about?
units.displayText: Is this the safehouse the Lieutenant was talking about?

spans.text: Is this the safehouse the Lieutenant was talking about?

units.rawText: If nobody had told me beforehand, I wouldn't have believed this unassuming little shack was a vital communications point for the defending troops.
units.displayText: If nobody had told me beforehand, I wouldn't have believed this unassuming little shack was a vital communications point for the defending troops.

spans.text: If nobody had told me beforehand, I wouldn't have believed this unassuming little shack was a vital communications point for the defending troops.

units.rawText: From the surroundings, we seem to be on the cusp of winter turning to spring. The heavy snowfall on the mountains is a form of natural protection for us, silently and cleverly concealing our trail.
units.displayText: From the surroundings, we seem to be on the cusp of winter turning to spring. The heavy snowfall on the mountains is a form of natural protection for us, silently and cleverly concealing our trail.

spans.text: From the surroundings, we seem to be on the cusp of winter turning to spring. The heavy snowfall on the mountains is a form of natural protection for us, silently and cleverly concealing our trail.

units.rawText: The flying snow enters the safehouse as we push open the heavy, frigid wooden door. After a brief period of fumbling around in the darkness, the lightbulb and hearth flare to life, once again awakening the warriors standing watch in these lonely mountains.
units.displayText: The flying snow enters the safehouse as we push open the heavy, frigid wooden door. After a brief period of fumbling around in the darkness, the lightbulb and hearth flare to life, once again awakening the warriors standing watch in these lonely mountains.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ah choo!</size>
units.displayText: Ah choo!

spans.text: Ah choo!

units.displayText: Guess it's a little chilly in here...

units.rawText: I might be a little clumsy at this sort of work, so I hope you don't mind... Ah! What happened to your arms?!

units.displayText: I've been trying to hide it, but Tony can still see the darkened skin.

spans.text: I've been trying to hide it, but Tony can still see the darkened skin.

units.rawText: Let me help you with that.

units.displayText: ...Thank you for your help, Centaureissi. Your bandaging technique is excellent; were you professionally trained?

spans.text: ...Thank you for your help, Centaureissi. Your bandaging technique is excellent; were you professionally trained?

units.rawText: Yes, Vayne taught me... she is my beloved little sister.
units.displayText: Yes, Vayne taught me... she is my beloved little sister.

spans.text: Yes, Vayne taught me... she is my beloved little sister.

units.rawText: Vayne?
units.displayText: Vayne?

spans.text: Vayne?

units.rawText: That name seems vaguely familiar...
units.displayText: That name seems vaguely familiar...

spans.text: That name seems vaguely familiar...

units.rawText: That's a nice name. I wish I could have met her.

units.rawText: ...Although, you're a civilian Doll just like me, aren't you? What's all this about a little sister, then?

spans.text: ...Although, you're a civilian Doll just like me, aren't you? What's all this about a little sister, then?

units.displayText: The logs in the fireplace crackle. A moment later, the glacier of memory begins to melt with the rising warmth.

spans.text: The logs in the fireplace crackle. A moment later, the glacier of memory begins to melt with the rising warmth.

units.rawText: Vayne was a human, but I have always thought of her as a little sister.
units.displayText: Vayne was a human, but I have always thought of her as a little sister.

spans.text: Vayne was a human, but I have always thought of her as a little sister.

units.rawText: Long ago, I was employed by a military household, and I was responsible for taking care of their daughter. This was how I came to know Vayne.
units.displayText: Long ago, I was employed by a military household, and I was responsible for taking care of their daughter. This was how I came to know Vayne.

spans.text: Long ago, I was employed by a military household, and I was responsible for taking care of their daughter. This was how I came to know Vayne.

units.rawText: She was a kind and sympathetic girl, and she always treated me as part of the family, even going so far as to call me her big sister.
units.displayText: She was a kind and sympathetic girl, and she always treated me as part of the family, even going so far as to call me her big sister.

spans.text: She was a kind and sympathetic girl, and she always treated me as part of the family, even going so far as to call me her big sister.

units.rawText: Vayne loved... she loved drawing. She would drag me to art exhibitions from a young age, where she would enjoy works from various artists.
units.displayText: Vayne loved... she loved drawing. She would drag me to art exhibitions from a young age, where she would enjoy works from various artists.

units.displayText: Ah, I like drawing too.

spans.text: Ah, I like drawing too.

units.rawText: Hehe, sounds like you and Vayne would have become friends if you'd met.
units.displayText: Hehe, sounds like you and Vayne would have become friends if you'd met.

spans.text: Hehe, sounds like you and Vayne would have become friends if you'd met.

units.rawText: ...Come to think of it, Vayne liked dressing up as a boy. Apparently her father got her into the habit. She had something that looked almost like what Chris is wearing now.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

units.rawText: We kept in touch at first, but as the fighting spread, I couldn't even contact her any more.

units.rawText: I believe that Vayne is still alive. As long as I keep looking for her, I'll be reunited with her again someday...

spans.text: I don't get it... Why would Vayne do something so dangerous?

units.displayText: Nowhere is safe now that the war's come this far.
